name: pi-herdr-subagents
description: Interactive subagent orchestration for pi, built natively on herdr — spawn, resume, and interrupt subagents in herdr panes with truthful lifecycle events
author: Christiano Higuto

scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm run test:contract && pnpm run test:integration:no-model
scripts.test:integration:no-model: node --test test/integration/harness-selftest.test.ts && PI_RUN_HERDR_INTEGRATION=1 node --test test/integration/no-model-smoke.test.ts && PI_RUN_HERDR_INTEGRATION=1 node --test test/integration/no-model-workflow.test.ts
